Kangana Ranaut challenges CJP to contest elections, defends government decision-making

Actress Kangana Ranaut has challenged the Citizens for Justice and Peace (CJP) to contest elections if they disagree with the government's decisions. She stated that elected governments have the right to make decisions and criticized disruptive protests in Parliament, advocating for accountable discussions on national issues.
